'To whoever keeps the light: thank you. My boat lost its engine off your coast in 1987, and your beam brought us home.' Marta read it three times. She had not been here in 1987; her father had. She carried the note up the spiral stairs, set it beside his old logbook, and for the first time in years lit the lamp early, smiling at the darkening water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，偶尔有一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，留下湿漉漉的水痕。高楼大多沉睡，只有几扇窗还亮着，像是未眠人的眼睛。早点铺的老板刚掀开蒸笼，白色的热气升腾而起，带着面粉的香味。环卫工人挥动扫帚，沙沙声在街巷间回荡。远处的天边泛起一线淡淡的青灰，新的一天正悄悄靠近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep opening until you reach the tiny one that does not open.\n- That tiny doll is the stopping point, and without it you would open dolls forever."}
